purpose: Separate lifecycle demonstrations, not additional experimental runs
network_fault: External localhost forwarder deliberately closes status-GET connection. Real Go application handles all successful requests; no fake snapshots or fetch replacement.
failure_fault: Temporarily rename only the newly uploaded demonstration copy, then restore after real worker failure.
proxy_limitation: During mode cancellation, the browser abort is real; this simple forwarder may keep its upstream request open until the next server response. These captures do not test backend cancellation cleanup.
screenshots: Actual Firefox full-page and native job-panel screenshots, plus raw logs and time-sampled job-panel GIF sequences. White padding only equalises frame dimensions.
